label: YOLOv7-tiny 416
source: WongKinYiu/yolov7 v0.1 release yolov7-tiny.pt (COCO 2017; copy in training/weights/). ONNX exported on the PC with training/vendor/yolov7/export.py --grid --simplify at 416, opset 12: --grid gives the same (1, N, 85) output as YOLOv5, hence decoder yolo_v5. Engine built on the Nano with trtexec --fp16.
